summary: A lean, playable deployment beat with a clear dramatic turn: Shalabi divides the ground, then Hassan quietly accepts the exposed rear position. The dialogue is period-appropriate, militarily credible and supported rather than duplicated by the aerial action.

lines.speaker: SHALABI

performance.delivery: Keep his eyes and finger on the map. Each pause marks a new position; the final instruction lands as the danger he has been calculating all along.

lines.text: فَصِيلَةْ هِنَا… كِيلُو… وِفَصِيلَةْ… كِيلُو… وِفَصِيلَةْ. وِكُلّْ فَصِيلَةْ تِسِيبْ جَمَاعَةْ وَرَا… تِحْمِي ضَهْرِنَا.

lines.speaker: SHALABI

performance.delivery: Look directly at Hassan and make the assignment personal without softening it. Tighten slightly on «مَحَدِّشْ» but never raise the voice.

lines.text: حَسَنْ… إِنْتَ وَرَا. مَحَدِّشْ يِيجِي مِنْ ضَهْرِنَا.

performance.delivery: Answer Shalabi plainly, almost as if confirming a routine task. Do not sell the heroism; let the danger register only in the stillness before «يَا فَنْدِمْ».
